S.FORM: == tatangahan(mikawaway-kalumyiti | mikawaway tu kalumyiti sakatizeng bangu) == misagiki,sapitanged tu alubu nu wawa "sow-lin-nang" kakilimn(mikawaway-kalumyiti | mikawaway tu kalumyiti sakatizeng bangu) misagiki,sapitanged tu alubu nu wawa "sow-lin-nang" i kasumamadan a mihcaan enemay a bulad sabaw walu a demiad, Deng Zeu a kakitaan a wawaan tu tatayna mikadabu ci Siye Siyang Ling. ya kelakela' i tepan nu zazan malikeluh tu ni kasangsang nu udad, i dabek "Cun Cyu Teng" a dabek mikisasa' tu udad,ayza satu mitupin tu pakuyucay a tademaw ci "Caw Suw Cen", u zumaay a kelakela' a tayzatu mikisasa' tu udad i dabek,pakuyucay ci "Caw Suw Cen", kaluway sa ku balucu' nikalikeluh tu ni kakitaan atu pakuyucay , misawacu tu pakuyucay, malalum ku balucu' muwangic ku pakuyucay a tademaw, hinadihi hinadiput ci Siyang Ling naykadabu a sinubu. siacaay a "sow-lin-nang" i labu izaw ku bunawan u siekim masaw. ya "sow-lin-nang" pabelinen ci "Caw Suw Cen" == nilaculan ==
S.PHON: == tataŋaħan(mikawawaj-kar~ɾumjiti | mikawawaj tu kar~ɾumjiti sakatizəŋ baŋu) == misagiki,sapitaŋəd tu ar~ɾubu nu wawa "sow-r~ɾin-naŋ" kakir~ɾimn(mikawawaj-kar~ɾumjiti | mikawawaj tu kar~ɾumjiti sakatizəŋ baŋu) misagiki,sapitaŋəd tu ar~ɾubu nu wawa "sow-r~ɾin-naŋ" i kasumamadan a miħʦaan ənəmaj a bur~ɾad sabaw war~ɾu a dəmiad, dəŋ zəu a kakitaan a wawaan tu tatajna mikadabu ʦi sijə sijaŋ r~ɾiŋ. ja kər~ɾakər~ɾaʔ~ʡ i təpan nu zazan mar~ɾikər~ɾuħ tu ni kasaŋsaŋ nu udad, i dabək "ʦun ʦju təŋ" a dabək mikisasaʔ~ʡ tu udad,ajza satu mitupin tu pakujuʦaj a tadəmaw ʦi "ʦaw suw ʦən", u zumaaj a kər~ɾakər~ɾaʔ~ʡ a tajzatu mikisasaʔ~ʡ tu udad i dabək,pakujuʦaj ʦi "ʦaw suw ʦən", kar~ɾuwaj sa ku bar~ɾuʦuʔ~ʡ nikar~ɾikər~ɾuħ tu ni kakitaan atu pakujuʦaj , misawaʦu tu pakujuʦaj, mar~ɾar~ɾum ku bar~ɾuʦuʔ~ʡ muwaŋiʦ ku pakujuʦaj a tadəmaw, ħinadiħi ħinadiput ʦi sijaŋ r~ɾiŋ najkadabu a sinubu. siaʦaaj a "sow-r~ɾin-naŋ" i r~ɾabu izaw ku bunawan u siəkim masaw. ja "sow-r~ɾin-naŋ" pabər~ɾinən ʦi "ʦaw suw ʦən" == nir~ɾaʦur~ɾan ==
